question: Why is one's own birthday considered a means of knowledge?
premises: One's own birthday is identified as a means of knowledge.
It is the cause of the body associated with enjoyment and liberation.
That body serves as the basis for spiritual practice and realization.
inference: One's birthday is ritually meaningful because it marks the arising of the body that enables knowledge, enjoyment, and liberation.
plain_english: Thus one's own birthday is said to be a means of knowledge, because it is the cause of the body through which such enjoyment, liberation, and so on become possible.
